I am examining the store layer deletion logic for memos to identify which related record types are removed before the memo row itself.

The store layer's `DeleteMemo` removes `memo_relation` records and attachments before deleting the memo row itself. Reactions, memo shares, and comment memos are not handled by the store layer; the API layer manages those separately.

I will also verify whether `DeleteAttachment` or the driver's `DeleteMemo` perform any additional cleanup.
